identity: Concept scene for a prehistoric adventure game. A Tyrannosaurus charges through a shallow jungle river, roaring up at a huge meteor streaking across the dusk sky behind it; water bursts up around its legs and a flock of small pterosaurs scatters from the trees. The Tyrannosaurus is the focal point; the meteor's fiery trail is the brightest light in the image and washes the scene in warm orange. Feeling: awe and danger, the end of an age. No people.
